description: This file implements web servlet process functions for HTTP methods like OPTIONS, GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, DELETE, TRACE, and CONNECT. It handles incoming web requests, invokes interface methods if available, or defaults to sending method not allowed responses. It includes licensing info, module description, and function prototypes relevant for a web server component.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BwspWsoDoOptions(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep)
methods.description: Processes an OPTIONS request, calls interface's DoOptions if available, otherwise replies with OK.

methods.description: Processes a POST request, calls interface's DoPost if available, otherwise responds with method not allowed and allowed methods list.
